decisions.why: Categories name distinct orthotic lines almost verbatim: Footwear/Insoles/Arch Supports (insole); Knee Braces/Splints and Braces (brace); Hand and Wrist Splints, Finger and Thumb Splints, Comfy Splints (upper); Lumbar (spine); Orthotic and Splinting Materials (materials). Examples (wrist brace, cast boot) confirm upper/brace lines.

Examples are general theatre consumables (Autoclip wound clips, Steri-Strip skin closures, Monocryl sutures, body straps); categories add armboards, hand tables, lithotomy accessories and general forceps/needle holders/curettes - all general OR consumables, not a specialty line.

Categories Dining Aids, Dressing Aids, Cups & Accessories, Bathing & Hygiene Aids match rehab:daily; examples of wheelchair replacement parts and Jay J2 wheelchair cushion plus Bariatric Wheelchairs category match rehab:chair.

Fall Management/Alarms and Sensors/AliMed Sensors categories match digital:tec's falls/sensor wording; example Full Face Shield is infection:ppe; Bed Positioners/Foam Wedges/Heel Protection/AliMed Positioner Set example match handling:mattress positioning.
Categories are explicitly Pediatric Orthotics, Pediatric Elbow/Knee/Ankle/Cervical Orthotics; examples are thermoplastic paediatric wrist/thumb supports, matching orthotics:paed directly.

Division name and categories (Sheathing Transducer Covers, Needle Guides, Elastics & Sterile Gel, Latex Non-Sterile covers) are ultrasound probe cover/accessory lines, matching ultrasound:trans directly.
